entities.name: Herman Tymiński

entities.summary: Herman Tymiński was an Orthodox priest active in the Grodno Governorate of the Russian Empire. He is remembered for his long and devoted ministry in Marian Sanctuary in the town of Krasnystok, where he revitalized religious life.
